title: Haber de + Infinitive: Formal Duty and Destiny
goal: Use haber de + infinitive for a formal duty and for what was going to happen.

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can use haber de + infinitive for a formal duty.
I can use había de + infinitive to say what was going to happen later.
I can use the new words for admitting something and taking your time.
